title: [observability] The Fleet page's human interventions per agent-hour is the Home card's (A22, part 2 of 100/103/102: with 100, A22's one definition)
prompt:
Read crates/spawn-postgres/src/fleet.rs (`FLEET_HEALTH`: the answer of `/api/fleet`'s `health`, its `human_per_agent_hour`) and crates/spawn-postgres/src/experience.rs (`INTERVENTIONS`: the answer of `/api/interventions`, the Home card), and the view `spawn_interventions` (crates/spawn-postgres/sql/schema.sql).

The problem (cc-astra A22, HIGH; sync/astra/findings.md), the Fleet page's half. Two figures named "human per agent-hour" disagree, and not by window: the Home card (`/api/interventions?window=24h`) counts what the owner had to do (a person's commands as intents, mission resumes, tasks a person assigned, cancel-and-reassign), while `/api/fleet`'s `health.human_per_agent_hour` (the Fleet page's health strip and the Scorecard's decisions view read it) counts the decisions ladder's human tier only, a person's commands. A resume or a task the owner assigned moves the Home card and not the Fleet page.

This is part of A22's fix, not all of it: objective 100 makes Core lines' figure the Home card's, this one makes the Fleet page's the same, and A22 counts as fixed only when both have landed; 102 then counts a pause as an intervention in every one of them.

Required behaviour.
- `/api/fleet`'s `health.human_per_agent_hour` is `/api/interventions?window=24h`'s `per_agent_hour` at the same now: the number of `spawn_interventions` rows with at_ms in [now - 24 h, now) over the same agent hours (`agent_hours_24h`, the executions' running time clipped to the day), to 3 decimals rounded half up as the card's; null with no agent time.
- Nothing else of `/api/fleet` changes: `ladder_24h` (the decisions ladder, `human` included) and `agent_hours_24h` stay as they are.
- The Fleet page's hint for the figure (web/src/components/fleet/HealthStrip.tsx, `HUMAN_RATE_HINT`) says what it now counts: each time a person stepped in (a command, a resume, a task they assigned, a cancel and reassign) in the last 24 h, over the hours agents ran; the Home card's figure.
- The docs (docs/fleet-architecture.md) say which view `health.human_per_agent_hour` reads.

Files (expected; no other open objective touches them): crates/spawn-postgres/src/fleet.rs, web/src/components/fleet/HealthStrip.tsx, docs/fleet-architecture.md (the two sentences on `human_per_agent_hour` and `spawn_interventions`). Keep the change small (well under 60 lines). The Scorecard's fleet scope (crates/spawn-cli/src/scorecard/fleet.rs, its own `human_per_agent_hour` over its window) is not this objective's.

Acceptance: rsi/scenarios/103.sh. It seeds 8 agent-hours, a mission resumed and a task a person assigned in the last day (no command in it) and a person's command 30 h ago, and reads /api/interventions (24h and 7d) and /api/fleet: the Fleet figure must be the card's 24 h per_agent_hour, 0.25, over agent_hours_24h 8, with ladder_24h.human still 0. The older scenarios that read /api/fleet's health (043, 049, 088) must still pass.
